title: Commercial Debt & Civil Money Recovery Workflow
description: End-to-end guided workflow for recovering unpaid commercial debts, from initial invoice assessment and chronology extraction to statutory demand notice preparation and pre-institution mediation.

steps.title: Client Intake & Debt Assessment
steps.objective: Screen invoices, identify contractual counterparty, and evaluate quantum of claim.
steps.prompt_guidance: Evaluate invoices and verify total outstanding debt and interest terms.
steps.expected_output: Quantified debt triage memo with limitation assessment.
steps.verification_gate: Confirm debt is within 3-year limitation period under Limitation Act 1963.

steps.title: Factual Timeline & Document Chronology
steps.objective: Construct objective chronology of purchase orders, deliveries, and payment demands.
steps.prompt_guidance: Extract dated chronology identifying admitted acknowledgments of debt.
steps.expected_output: Chronological evidence matrix with exhibit mappings.
steps.verification_gate: Ensure all electronic communications have Section 63 BSA certificate trails.

steps.title: Pre-Litigation Legal Notice Drafting
steps.objective: Formulate formal demand notice giving statutory cure period prior to suit.
steps.prompt_guidance: Draft notice demanding payment within 15 days under threat of commercial suit.
steps.verification_gate: Supervising advocate review and signature before issuance via Registered Post.

steps.title: Pre-Institution Mediation & Commercial Court Filing
steps.objective: Initiate mandatory pre-institution mediation under Section 12A Commercial Courts Act.
required_inputs: Proof of service of legal notice
steps.prompt_guidance: Draft application for pre-institution mediation at District Legal Services Authority.
steps.expected_output: DLSA mediation application and draft commercial plaint.
steps.verification_gate: Confirm verification clause compliance under Order VI Rule 15A CPC.
